claims.claim_text: At approximately 0115 hours, I was patrolling the rear parking lot.
I observed a silver two-door Honda Civic parked behind the Total Woman Gym in the southernmost stall near the dumpster enclosure.
The vehicle was parked facing east.
The Patrol Video System in my vehicle was also recording during this incident.
The subject refused to open the door or roll down the window for approximately two minutes.
At approximately 0117 hours, I radioed dispatch that I was conducting a vehicle check and requested Code 1 assistance.
Officer Rojas arrived on scene within approximately two minutes of my Code 1 request and positioned Unit #13 behind my vehicle, approximately thirty feet from the Honda.
Officer Rojas agreed we should proceed immediately.
Sergeant Torres and additional officers arrived approximately fifteen minutes after my initial contact.
Dispatch advised that the Honda was registered to the subject and that the subject had no prior criminal history.
Officer Herrera began giving the subject commands in both English and Spanish for approximately ninety seconds.
Officer Dunn fired the first 40mm Less Lethal projectile into the passenger side window, shattering the glass.
The round struck the front bumper of Unit #13.
I observed the subject seated in the driver's seat.
I was wearing a PPD uniform with a Body Worn Camera activated throughout.
Officer Rojas arrived on scene within approximately two minutes of my Code 1 request and positioned Unit #13 behind my vehicle, approximately thirty feet from the Honda.
The subject was pronounced deceased at approximately 0150 hours.
